Definition: something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress)
BiblicalUsage: A mantle, a wide garment, a robe — addereth is the cloak that marks a prophet. Esau came out "all over like an hairy garment"; Elijah wrapped his face in his mantle at Horeb, cast it on Elisha, and struck the Jordan with it; Elisha took it up when his master was gone; and false prophets are warned not to wear "a rough garment to deceive." The mantle passes from prophet to prophet, and the garment itself is never the point.
TheologicalSignificance: A mantle is cloth, not power, and the lesson is that the Spirit passed with it from Elijah to Elisha because God gives His Spirit to whom He will.
